title: The Lookout
synopsis: A test room for #134: locks the group has to find, and a final lock built from the others.

stages.title: The Hold
stages.description: A dark hold with a hatch above.

stages.title: The Deck
stages.description: The open deck, and a gangplank that won't come down until every lock up here is open.

objects.label: mast
objects.look: A locker at its foot, with a word lock.

objects.label: barrel
objects.look: A spyglass, rolled under the barrel.

objects.label: net
objects.look: Seaweed, and a little door behind it.

puzzles.title: The Hatch
puzzles.prompt: The hatch wants the magic word.
puzzles.solvedText: Up you go, with a red flag that was tucked under the hatch.

puzzles.title: The Knot Board
puzzles.prompt: How many knots on the board?
puzzles.solvedText: A bottle rolls out from behind the board.

puzzles.title: The Flag Locker
puzzles.prompt: The locker at the foot of the mast wants a colour.

puzzles.title: The Message in a Bottle
puzzles.prompt: The message wants a word from the reef.

puzzles.title: The Signal
puzzles.prompt: Wave the red flag at the passing ship. What does it shout back?

puzzles.title: The Far Shore
puzzles.prompt: Through the spyglass: what's that on the horizon?

puzzles.title: The Gangplank
puzzles.prompt: The gangplank's keypad wants {count} digits. Every lock on deck left a mark when it opened.
hints: Read the marks in the order painted on the lifeboat.
